scope: Restart of the all-odd-Spin common canonical-EB comparator line. New finite exact checks and one exact support rescue are recorded; the all-n theorem remains unknown.

claims.exact_statement: For d_k=binom(2n+1,k), D_{k,r}=diag(mu_{k,r},...,mu_{k,n}), L_{k,r}=I-D_{k,r}/d_k, and orthogonal swap involution F_r, the termwise star inequality D_{k,r}+F_r D_{k,r} F_r <= d_k I is equivalent to L_{k,r}+F_r L_{k,r} F_r >= I. Also mu_{k,j}/d_k is the uniform average over |A|=k of (-1)^(k j-|A intersect J|) for fixed |J|=j, so L's diagonal is twice the probability that this sign is -1.
assumptions: The inherited all-n Spin(2n+1) representation reduction and Choi/star convention are correct.
F_r is the real orthogonal output-swap involution in the declared coupling basis.
claims.novelty_boundary: This recasts the proposed shortcut as a complementarity/spectral-gap problem; it does not establish the gap or claim novelty.
claims.costs: Closed binomial identity and a two-line operator rearrangement; no numerical cost.
claims.falsifier: An incorrect Krawtchouk sign convention, pair basis, or swap involution invalidates the reduction.
claims.next_gate: Prove or refute L_{k,r}+F_r L_{k,r}F_r >= I uniformly for every n, k, and r>=1.

claims.exact_statement: At n=6 (Spin(13)), for every grade k=1,...,6 and every extracted output-swap block with r=1,...,6, the exact reduced Gram gap C(13,k)G-B_{k,r} is positive semidefinite. All 66 grade/block gaps pass all 222 exact rational principal-minor checks.
assumptions: The inherited Spin(13) sparse highest-weight extraction and exact Gram/bilinear matrices are correct.
Every present output-swap block is included; the r=0 blocks are intentionally excluded.
claims.novelty_boundary: One dimension only; replays saved reduced blocks and does not prove the all-n termwise claim, the r=0 inequality, or the common comparator theorem.
claims.costs: Exact rational principal-minor arithmetic on blocks of order at most six; no dense 262144x262144 matrix.
claims.falsifier: Any negative/undecided exact principal minor in the stated list or an omitted r>=1 swap block.
claims.next_gate: Find a dimension-uniform proof or exact n>6 violation of the recoupling gap; keep r=0 separate.

claims.exact_statement: At n=7, the original eight Jordan-Wigner attained seed vectors do not satisfy the candidate r=0 star upper inequality on all rays of their support cones: exact checks give three failures among 40 rays and 10200 principal minors. On alpha=e5+e6, the seed support is 62, the trace term is 8008, and the exact 8x8 gap determinant is negative.
assumptions: The all-n r=0 recoupling formula and exact Krawtchouk diagonals in r0_seed_cone_probe.py are correct.
The finite support is exactly the maximum over the eight listed attained psi_h seeds, not full canonical support.
claims.novelty_boundary: Refutes only the eight-seed sufficient comparator at these rays. This is not a legal channel, global canonical-support counterexample, or refutation of the factor-two claim.
claims.costs: Exact symbolic 8x8 matrices and exact cone-ray enumeration; 10200 principal minors.
claims.falsifier: An error in the exact r=0 recoupling formula, the seed moment formula, or the recorded negative determinant.
claims.next_gate: Use the full support h_7(alpha) or an attained state strong enough to compare against a rigorous star upper bound.

claims.exact_statement: For n=7 and alpha=e5+e6, all 255 exact principal minors of (80711/10)I-H_{alpha,0} are nonnegative. An explicitly recorded normalized rational Spin(15) pure spinor has s5+s6=6290353328/99460729>63/10. Since the trace term is 8008, lambda_max(H_{alpha,0})-8008<=63/10<s5+s6<=h_7(alpha), so the full-support star inequality holds for this one ray and block.
assumptions: The r=0 recoupling matrix in r0_seed_cone_probe.py represents the exact star block in the declared orthonormal basis.
The rational amplitude coordinates and exact Clifford-word moment replay in spin15_rational_seed.py are correct.
claims.novelty_boundary: Rescues one direction in one block and diagnoses one false finite-seed obstruction; no n-uniform, all-r, channel, or novelty claim.
claims.costs: 128 complex amplitudes with integer numerators, exact Clifford-word moment sums, and 255 exact principal minors of an 8x8 matrix.
claims.falsifier: A changed Clifford phase convention that invalidates the moment replay, a negative exact principal minor, or reversal of the exact rational support comparison.
claims.next_gate: Find exact attained support witnesses or an analytic h_7 lower bound for the two remaining augmented-seed rays; then prove the continuous-support r=0 inequality uniformly in n.
